note: Keys that differ between coreav ffprobe and the pinned ffprobe 9.0.2 on the generated fixtures, the files they differ on, and the difference each entry accepts, by entry of docs/known-divergences-ffprobe9.md. tools/compat-corpus/run.py sets a difference aside only when the two outputs are the same once these keys of that file are taken out of both, and every value that differs on them is the difference the entry's accepts names.

conditions.track: an audio track of an unfragmented movie, without composition offsets, with one sample description, which every chunk names, an mp4a with an AudioSpecificConfig of AAC LC (object type 2) at the media time scale, with no dependsOnCoreCoder or extensionFlag, then the extension that rules SBR out (0x2b7, object type 5, sbrPresentFlag 0) and nothing else, since without it implicit SBR is open at any core rate (ISO/IEC 14496-3 1.6.5.3); its frame is 960 or 1,024 samples by frameLengthFlag
conditions.edits: exactly an empty edit of nonzero duration, then one media edit at rate 1 from media time 0 or later that starts at or before the last sample and reaches the end of the samples, its duration counted in media ticks rounded down; the empty edit's duration counted in media ticks rounded to the nearest, halves up as ffprobe 9.0.2 does
conditions.samples: the media header's duration is the samples' total, and the last sample lasts less than a frame and starts inside the media edit
conditions.candidate: the frame less the last sample's duration
conditions.reference: the last sample's time less the media time plus the empty edit's duration in media ticks (p), plus a frame, less the end of the samples, when p is before that end and p plus the last sample's duration is after it
conditions.occurrence: the last packet of that track, by its offset and size; both values present and different
conditions.excludable: not yet: no corpus row is excluded under these conditions until the byte-derived predicate oracle_kd.empty_edit_padding (coreav-dev/coreav#160) gates them in the corpus comparator; the absence case only through its ProvenAbsence evidence and corpus_absence below; only the fixture scope (keys, accepts) applies now
conditions.absence: a second case: the media time scale is the configuration's core rate, so a frame spans 1,024 or 960 ticks by frameLengthFlag whatever SBR does; the last sample lasts exactly that span, and its decoded frame ends at or before the media edit's end, so nothing is decoded past the presentation; the configuration needs no extension (zero bytes after it signal none) and the media header may differ from the samples; CoreAV lists no side data on that packet and ffprobe exactly the value 'reference' gives with that frame, every other packet agreeing; a last sample shorter than a frame never qualifies

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6: the media edit ends the presentation at its end in media time, so a last sample ending at or before it has nothing past it to discard; ffprobe 9.0.2 places the packet after the empty edit but keeps that end in media time

conditions.track: a Matroska or WebM audio track with CodecID A_AC3, no ContentEncodings and at least one frame
conditions.frames: every frame of every SimpleBlock and Block of the track, a lace split into its frames (RFC 9559 10.3), is exactly one AC-3 syncframe: its sample rate and frame size codes are listed (ATSC A/52 tables 5.6 and 5.18), it is that size, and its first 5/8 pass crc1 (7.10.1); each has bsid 6, acmod above 2 and xbsi1e 1, no reserved surround level code (0 to 2) where acmod has surround channels, and every frame states the same five values; every element of the Segment lies within its parent and the file, with a complete header and a known size, so that every block is read
conditions.candidate: dmix_mode the stated dmixmod; each mix level the gain of its code (tables D2.3 to D2.6: 2^((2 - code) / 4), code 7 muting, to six decimals) where Annex D 2.3.1.2 to 2.3.1.6 define it, the centre levels with a centre channel and the surround levels with surround channels, else 0.000000
conditions.reference: 0 for dmix_mode and 0.000000 for the four levels
conditions.occurrence: the stream of that track, by its position among the track entries and its TrackNumber; the stated values not all those of the reference; both sides exactly these
conditions.excludable: not yet: no corpus row is excluded under these conditions until the byte-derived evidence oracle_kd_mkv.annex_d_downmix gates them in the corpus comparator; the record has no fixture scope

entries.basis: ATSC A/52 Annex D 2.3.1.2 to 2.3.1.6: bsid 6 states the alternate syntax, which gives these fields their meaning, and Annex D 3.2 lets a legacy decoder ignore them without making the stream state no downmix; ffprobe 9.0.2 prints none; the mechanism KD-TS-ANNEX-D-DOWNMIX records for MPEG-TS (coreav-dev/coreav#146)

conditions.track: a video track with CodecID V_AV1 and no ContentEncodings, whose CodecPrivate is the four octets of the AV1 codec mapping in Matroska (marker and version 0x81), then exactly one sequence header OBU, complete through film_grain_params_present and ending in its trailing bits (AV1 5.5, 5.3.4), then only metadata OBUs, every OBU but the last with its size; every element read for the track lies within its parent; the four octets state the sequence header's mono_chrome, subsampling_x, subsampling_y and chroma_sample_position
conditions.sequence header: seq_profile 0 to 2, seq_level_idx[0] 0 to 23, mono_chrome 0, subsampling_x and subsampling_y 1, chroma_sample_position 0, color_description_present_flag 1 with color_primaries, transfer_characteristics and matrix_coefficients 1, color_range 0
conditions.colour: each of the track's Colour elements Range, BitsPerChannel, Primaries, TransferCharacteristics, MatrixCoefficients, ChromaSitingHorz and ChromaSitingVert that is stored holds what the AV1 codec mapping in Matroska derives from the sequence header: Range 1, BitsPerChannel its bit depth, Primaries, TransferCharacteristics and MatrixCoefficients 1, ChromaSitingHorz and ChromaSitingVert 0
conditions.reference: av01.<seq_profile>.<seq_level_idx[0], two digits><M or H by seq_tier[0]>.<bit depth, two digits> from the sequence header, then .0.110.01.01.01.0
conditions.occurrence: the stream of that track, by its position among the track entries and its TrackNumber; both strings exactly these
conditions.excludable: not yet: no corpus row is excluded under these conditions until the byte-derived evidence oracle_kd_mkv.av1_default_suffix gates them in the corpus comparator; the record has no fixture scope

entries.basis: AV1-ISOBMFF section 5: a codec string that ends with .0.110.01.01.01.0 SHOULD omit it, and omitted optional fields take those default values; ffprobe 9.0.2 keeps the suffix, which the section permits but does not recommend, and CoreAV omits it

conditions.track: a video track with CodecID V_AV1 and no ContentEncodings, whose CodecPrivate is the four octets of the AV1 codec mapping in Matroska (marker and version 0x81), then exactly one sequence header OBU, complete through film_grain_params_present and ending in its trailing bits (AV1 5.5, 5.3.4), then only metadata OBUs, every OBU but the last with its size; every element read for the track lies within its parent; the four octets state the sequence header's mono_chrome, subsampling_x, subsampling_y and chroma_sample_position
conditions.sequence header: seq_profile 0 to 2, seq_level_idx[0] 0 to 23, mono_chrome 0, subsampling_x and subsampling_y 1, chroma_sample_position 1, color_description_present_flag 0, color_range 0
conditions.colour: each of the track's Colour elements Range, BitsPerChannel, Primaries, TransferCharacteristics, MatrixCoefficients, ChromaSitingHorz and ChromaSitingVert that is stored holds what the AV1 codec mapping in Matroska derives from the sequence header: Range 1, BitsPerChannel its bit depth, Primaries, TransferCharacteristics and MatrixCoefficients 2, ChromaSitingHorz 1 and ChromaSitingVert 2
conditions.reference: av01.<seq_profile>.<seq_level_idx[0], two digits><M or H by seq_tier[0]>.<bit depth, two digits> from the sequence header, without optional fields
conditions.occurrence: the stream of that track, by its position among the track entries and its TrackNumber; both strings exactly these
conditions.excludable: not yet: no corpus row is excluded under these conditions until the byte-derived evidence oracle_kd_mkv.av1_chroma_position gates them in the corpus comparator; the record has no fixture scope

entries.basis: AV1-ISOBMFF section 5: the third chromaSubsampling digit SHALL equal chroma_sample_position, and without a colour description the colour fields SHOULD take the default values; omitted optional fields mean chromaSubsampling 110, so ffprobe 9.0.2's string misstates chroma_sample_position 1 as 0, and CoreAV's states 111
